Normalized Heritage (RFI v1.0). Ported to Roll for Initiation: 7-damage-type canon, Soma Break, Tier-based scaling, reroll-lowest. Replaces the D&D5E heritage draft dated 2026-04-19 00:10.

“Cherubim guard with flaming swords. You guard with a look.”

Sephirotic Scion (Cherubic). Order: watchful. Gates, doors, names, oaths recognize you.

Heritage Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Sephirotic).
  • Size. Medium. Speed: normal.
  • Gate-Warden. See your signature feat, The Gate Knows You.
  • Name-Held. Creatures you have spoken with for at least one minute cannot hide their true name from divination you cast or from divination that targets you.
  • Unblinking. You are immune to magical sleep (narrative, GM enforces). Reroll the lowest die on checks to resist the calmed condition.
  • Signature. You gain The Gate Knows You at character creation.

Engine note. Where this heritage grants a damage-type resistance, it is applied by the fourththing defense engine via flags.fourththing.grants. Narrative immunities (sleep, forced movement, cold iron) are descriptive only until the Phase 3 condition-and-flavor engine ships.
